name: d-bond-local-control
description: Configure D-Bond and exchange paired direct or Dot messages through one local plugin.

interface.longDescription: Inspect local connections and traces, edit owner rules with version checks, and use the same paired direct and Dot messaging backend. Registration is tied to an exact host chat; receipts distinguish stored messages from agent answers and verified wake checks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show my D-Bond connections, register this exact chat if requested, and help with paired messages or connection rules.
